ارتعشوا (form VIII)
# اِرْتَعَشُوا (irtaʕašū) /ir.ta.ʕa.ʃuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِرْتَعَشَ (irtaʕaša)
# اِرْتَعِشُوا (irtaʕišū) /ir.ta.ʕi.ʃuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِرْتَعَشَ (irtaʕaša)
